vherathi_spire.name: Vherathi Spire
vherathi_spire.description: A tapering residential/administrative tower - it commits to the lean, base to tip, and clusters its light near the crown.

vherathi_bloompod.name: Vherathi Bloompod
vherathi_bloompod.description: A grown communal dwelling - an egg, taller and fuller on one flank as if it grew toward a light, its windows following that side.

vherathi_hall.name: Vherathi Gathering Hall
vherathi_hall.description: A wide, low market/meeting hall - the left eave sweeps far higher than the right, and the windows huddle low under it.

vherathi_concierge_desk.name: Vherathi Concierge Desk
vherathi_concierge_desk.description: A curved resin service desk, one wing longer than the other, its lip traced with terminal-glow. Furniture: a low collision footprint.

vherathi_bench.name: Vherathi Resin Bench
vherathi_bench.description: A grown seating ridge, gently curved, one end swept higher than the other. Furniture: a low collision footprint.

vherathi_planter.name: Vherathi Fern Basin
vherathi_planter.description: A grown basin in 3/4 view - the resin-ferns crowd and spill over one lip and thin out across it, and the basin itself is pinched narrower on the crowded side. Furniture: a small collision footprint.

vherathi_lamp.name: Vherathi Light Column
vherathi_lamp.description: A slender resin column, brightest at the crown - lighting only. Furniture: a tiny collision footprint.

vherathi_seat_pod.name: Vherathi Lounge Pod
vherathi_seat_pod.description: A grown lounge seat with a clear mouth on one side and the opposite rim swept up thick like a headrest, its glow nodes marching along that raised back. Furniture: a small collision footprint.

vherathi_dock_antler.name: Vherathi Dock Antler
vherathi_dock_antler.description: A grown ship-berth arm: one thick trunk splitting into uneven prongs, the longest traced with light. Anchored at ground level.

vherathi_vein_arch.name: Vherathi Vein Arch
vherathi_vein_arch.description: A grown archway over a corridor, one leg thicker than the other, brightest at an off-centre keystone. Decorative: no collision, walk under it.

drossholt_bunker.name: Drossholt Bunker
drossholt_bunker.description: A squat, riveted storage bunker - blunt plate armor bolted over whatever's inside.

drossholt_tower.name: Drossholt Watch Tower
drossholt_tower.description: A blocky comms and watch tower welded up from mismatched hull plate.

drossholt_warehouse.name: Drossholt Warehouse
drossholt_warehouse.description: A wide, low storage hall - the outpost's main cargo hub.

drossholt_desk.name: Drossholt Duty Desk
drossholt_desk.description: A welded plate counter with a riveted front and a row of status lamps. Furniture: a low collision footprint.

drossholt_bench.name: Drossholt Plate Bench
drossholt_bench.description: A bench cut from hull plate and bolted to a pair of stanchions. Furniture: a low collision footprint.

drossholt_planter.name: Drossholt Scrub Tub
drossholt_planter.description: A cut-down tank of hardy grey-green scrub, drawn in 3/4 view. Furniture: a small collision footprint.

drossholt_lamp.name: Drossholt Work Light
drossholt_lamp.description: A caged lamp clamped to a length of scaffold pipe - lighting only. Furniture: a tiny collision footprint.

drossholt_crate.name: Drossholt Cargo Stack
drossholt_crate.description: A lashed stack of shipping crates, corners scuffed to bare metal, stencilled on the faces. Furniture: a small collision footprint.

drossholt_barrel.name: Drossholt Drum
drossholt_barrel.description: A dented pressure drum, banded and stencilled. Furniture: a small collision footprint.

drossholt_gantry_rig.name: Drossholt Gantry Rig
drossholt_gantry_rig.description: A bolted scaffold gantry straddling a ship berth on a mirrored pair of legs. Decorative: no collision, walk under it.

drossholt_pipe_rail.name: Drossholt Pipe Rail
drossholt_pipe_rail.description: A bolted scaffold-pipe railing on evenly spaced uprights. Furniture: a thin collision footprint so you can't walk through it.

issue_block.name: Issue Block
issue_block.description: A Federation residential/admin tower - identical floor modules stacked, rounded corners, a regular window grid.

issue_shed.name: Issue Shed
issue_shed.description: A Federation hangar/warehouse module - a wide low box with a rounded roll-door and a clerestory window band.

issue_bollard.name: Issue Bollard
issue_bollard.description: A Federation marker post with an amber cap light and a reflective band - lighting only. Furniture: a tiny footprint.

issue_bench.name: Issue Bench
issue_bench.description: A Federation moulded seat shell on two standard legs, painted hull-blue with a white edge. Furniture: a low footprint.

issue_desk.name: Issue Duty Desk
issue_desk.description: A moulded Federation service counter with a white edge and a row of status lamps. Furniture: a low collision footprint.
